name: Piper PA-24 Comanche
summary: Sleek, fast four-to-six-seat retractable single built 1958–72, prized by owner-pilots and served by an active type club.

engines: Single flat engine in a long, sleek cowl
fuselage: Sleek four-to-six-seat cabin with a single right-side door

tellTales: Sleek retractable low-wing single with a swept fin and stabilator
Strongly tapered wing with marked dihedral

confusedWith.howToTell: Most PA-28s have fixed gear and a constant-chord or only partly tapered wing; the Comanche has retractable gear and a fully tapered wing.
The Mooney's vertical tail appears swept forward; the Comanche's fin is swept back.
The Bonanza has a conventional elevator and a larger, rounder cabin with rear double doors; the Comanche has a stabilator and a single door.
